name: Fix something that does not work
definition: asks to repair a feature the app already has, which fails, crashes, shows wrong data or disappeared because of a malfunction.

name: Ticket purchase
definition: buying tickets and carnets, special fares, multi-person or return tickets, guest checkout, choosing stations when buying.

name: Subscriptions and passes
definition: buying, renewing, activating, viewing or digitising subscriptions, passes and cards, including Io Viaggio.

name: Payments and invoices
definition: payment methods and wallets, saved cards, PayPal, Satispay, Google Pay, transport bonus, invoices, receipts and billing data.

name: Tickets and QR codes
definition: viewing, downloading, printing, emailing, sharing or validating tickets and QR codes, including offline access.

name: Train information
definition: new information to show, such as platform, cause of delays, cancellations shown clearly, train type or line name. Wrong or late data goes to "Fix something that does not work".

name: Favourites, widgets and trip planning
definition: favourite trains, stations and lines, saved routes, widgets, shortcuts, search filters and route planning.

name: Notifications
definition: push notifications, reminders, alert timing and preferences, marking notifications as read.

name: Login and account
definition: registration, staying logged in, password, biometrics, profile and personal data, linking cards to the account.

name: Complaints and support in the app
definition: sending complaints, asking for refunds or contacting support from inside the app.

name: Usability and design
definition: simpler interface, clearer wording, navigation, language support, dark mode, performance, device compatibility.

name: Other features
definition: anything specific not covered above, such as maps, bikes or regional coverage.

name: Too vague to classify
definition: no specific feature or change can be read from the review.
